M & Z Founders · Sisters EST. 2026
HERITAGE & PURPOSE

Two Sisters.
One Shared Love.

Maezy began with two sisters, Mariya and Zahabiya, and a quiet obsession with exquisite craftsmanship. For them, a piece of jewellery could transform an outfit, hold a lifelong memory, or make an ordinary day feel deeply special.

The name draws inspiration from “mazy”—intricate, poetic, and full of beautiful twists—while echoing the Greek “mazí”, which translates to together.

Every piece delivers the optical weight, pavé security, and lavish brilliance of high jewellery at an accessible, wearable investment.
